evidence.source: 漢語多功能字庫（香港中文大學人文電算研究中心）
evidence.text: The entry interprets early 左 forms as 𠂇, a left hand, and says later bronze forms add 工. It reports 左 for the direction ‘left’ in oracle-bone and bronze writing, and for ‘assist’ in bronze inscriptions as an early form of 佐, citing 虢季子白盤 and 晉公盆. Its transmitted 說文 explanation links 𠂇 and 工 with assistance; Duan Yucai distinguishes the directional 𠂇 from the assisting sense. The page does not date the cited examples or establish whether 工 has a phonetic role.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫：左

evidence.text: The record lists oracle-bone, bronze, Chu bamboo/silk, small-seal, and 說文 form categories, identifies a bronze record as 集成04313, and says an ancient form of 左 depicts a person's left hand. It does not give an archaeological date for an individual oracle-bone example.
evidence.title: 漢字「左」：字形演變

evidence.field: Summary; Source; Permission; Licensing; file history
evidence.text: The exact file page identifies 左-seal.svg as a modern vector depicting 左 in Shuowen seal-script style. It names Sinica, Chinese Etymology, and other databases as sources, and states CC0/public-domain terms. Upload dates document the artwork's file history, not the age of the historical graph. The page also references a 27.5DE6 Xiaoxuetang image, but this does not itself establish that the SVG is a primary artifact image.
evidence.title: File:左-seal.svg

evidence.text: The exact page describes Shuowen Seal Radical 077.svg as one of the 540 Shuowen radicals in small-seal script, credits it as the uploader's own work, and licenses it CC BY-SA 3.0. The Commons category identifies it as 𠂇. It is a modern redraw of a seal-script form, not a photo of an ancient inscription.
evidence.title: File:Shuowen Seal Radical 077.svg

evidence.field: Summary; Source; Permission; Licensing; file history
evidence.text: The exact page identifies 工-seal.svg as a modern vector depicting 工 in Shuowen seal-script style, cites Sinica among its sources, and states CC0/public-domain terms. It is an isolated 工 form and does not depict the debated addition of 工 within 左.
evidence.title: File:工-seal.svg

evidence.text: The linked notice states that site content, including text and images, is protected intellectual property and generally may only be browsed or used personally for noncommercial purposes absent a separate agreement. Thus the character database's image is not proposed here as an asset; the separately licensed Commons file is used instead.
evidence.title: 智財權聲明

evidence.text: The supplied local Unihan row gives 工 kMandarin gōng. Its official direct per-character record could not be opened in this run, so gōng is recorded as a local value rather than externally verified on that record. A modern reading alone does not establish 工's historical phonetic role in 左.
evidence.title: Unihan Database Lookup: U+5DE5 (direct record inaccessible)

evidence.text: The supplied local Unihan row gives 𠂇 kMandarin zuǒ. The official direct per-character record could not be opened in this run; this is local data, not a verified value on the official record page. This modern reading does not establish a historical sound role.
evidence.title: Unihan Database Lookup: U+21807 (direct record inaccessible)

evidence.field: sources/baxter-sagart/baxtersagart.tsv; rows for 工 and 左
evidence.text: The supplied local table gives 工 MC kuwng, OC *kˤoŋ (glosses ‘officer’ and ‘work’), while 左 has distinct rows MC tsaX, OC *tsˤa[j]ʔ (‘left (side)’ and ‘assist’) and MC tsaH, OC *tsˤarʔ-s (‘assist’). No 𠂇 row is present in the supplied rows. These readings do not establish a phonetic relationship between 工 and 左 or a historical sound role for 𠂇.
evidence.title: 左（存檔 Wiktionary 頁；secondary click-through for Baxter–Sagart data）

search_audit.query: 左 甲骨 金文 工 字形演變 中大 多功能字庫
search_audit.outcome: Search and opened the CUHK character record and Sinica evolution record. They support the left-hand interpretation, later bronze forms with 工, reported directional and assisting uses, and script categories; individual inscription dates remain unavailable.

Search results exposed the exact 左-seal.svg and Shuowen Seal Radical 077 description-page contents, including identity and rights. Attempts to open those pages and the direct original SVG URLs returned cache/access errors; the source-page content was available from search results. The left seal form is an illustrative modern vector; no original artifact photograph was verified.
Opened the exact 工-seal.svg page and verified its identity, modern vector nature, cited sources, and CC0/public-domain terms. It is an isolated seal form of 工 and does not illustrate 工's role in 左.

Official Unihan per-character record attempts for 工, 左 and 𠂇 each returned internal access errors. The Xiaoxuetang rights page and additional exact Commons pages also failed to open directly. The official Sinica database rights link did open and states restrictive personal/noncommercial use absent separate agreement.
The search returned unrelated oracle glyph files rather than the specified 左 file; these were not selected. No additional 左 oracle image provenance was verified.

gaps: Official Unicode direct pages for 工 and 𠂇 did not load; their listed Mandarin readings gōng and zuǒ remain supplied local data and are not cited as externally verified. The direct 左 record page also failed in this run.

The exact Commons pages for 左-seal.svg and Shuowen Seal Radical 077.svg were returned with identity and license content in search results, but direct page and image opens failed with cache/access errors. The original image byte stream was therefore not independently inspected in this run.

The exact seal-radical 077 page identifies a modern redraw and CC BY-SA 3.0, but the entry's central comparison is between early hand form and later graph; the candidate is less useful than a sourced 左 example and is omitted.
工-seal.svg is CC0 but depicts standalone 工, not 工 as incorporated in 左; it is not selected for the entry.

No individually dated oracle-bone example or dated first occurrence of the directional or assisting sense was verified. The CUHK cited bronze inscriptions were not independently opened and dated; relative chronology and the semantic connection remain unsettled.

Neither checked paleographic account establishes whether 工 contributes semantic content, phonetic content, or both. The local Baxter–Sagart rows for 工 and 左 are different host readings and do not establish their relation; no independent 𠂇 row was supplied.

No small tracked extract is recommended: reuse permission for repeated database text was not established, and character-specific citations suffice. The Sinica database notice expressly restricts general reuse of its content absent a separate agreement.

items.period: Small-seal script tradition; the file page identifies Shuowen seal-script style but gives no date for the underlying graph
items.caption: A modern vector redraw of 左 in Shuowen seal-script style, useful as a later comparison form. It is not an ancient inscription photograph and does not by itself establish the early hand form or the history of 工.
items.alt: Black seal-script strokes forming 左 on a white square.
items.selection_reason: The exact Commons description page identifies the graph, style, cited database sources, and reuse terms. It provides a documented later form to compare with the reported early 𠂇 form.
items.rights: CC0 1.0 / public-domain dedication, as stated on the Commons file page.

limitations.text: The chosen glyph is a modern vector redraw, not an image of a dated artifact. Its file page was retrievable in search output, while direct page and image requests failed in this run; the image itself was not visually inspected here.
The rights notice for the Sinica character database restricts general reuse absent separate agreement; no Sinica database glyph image is selected or mirrored.
